cases.name: affine-q-serre-q2

sources.title: Terwilliger, The q-Onsager algebra and the positive part of U_q(affine sl2) (2015)
sources.location: Equations (1)-(4); PBW basis and graded algebra

cases.interpretation: Positive part U_q(affine sl2) at q=2, over Q. Relations have total degree FOUR although called cubic q-Serre in the literature.
cases.adaptation: Exact q=2 specialization; nonzero, not a root of unity over Q; no commutative replacement.

cases.name: affine-q-serre-q3

sources.title: Terwilliger, The q-Onsager algebra and the positive part of U_q(affine sl2) (2015)
sources.location: Equations (1)-(4); PBW basis and graded algebra

cases.interpretation: Positive part U_q(affine sl2) at q=3, over Q. Relations have total degree FOUR although called cubic q-Serre in the literature.
cases.adaptation: Exact q=3 specialization; nonzero, not a root of unity over Q; no commutative replacement.

cases.name: homogenized-q-onsager-q2

sources.title: Terwilliger, The q-Onsager algebra and the positive part of U_q(affine sl2) (2015)
sources.location: Equations (1)-(4); PBW basis and graded algebra

cases.interpretation: Central homogenization of q-Onsager at q=2; the dehomogenization t=1 is the source algebra.
cases.adaptation: Explicit central homogenization. Not the original nonhomogeneous input; no Hilbert series is assumed merely from homogenizing relations.

cases.name: sklyanin-1-2-3

sources.title: Iyudu and Shkarin, Sklyanin algebras and a cubic root of 1 (2021)
Walton, Representation theory of three-dimensional Sklyanin algebras

cases.interpretation: Quadratic Sklyanin algebra with parameters (1,2,3); supersymmetric gauge-theory superpotential relations. Included for difficulty, not because its defining degree is high.
cases.adaptation: Exact rational parameters (p,q,r)=(1,2,3), satisfying the cited nondegeneracy condition.

cases.name: metab3

sources.title: Hofstadler and Levandovskyy, Modular Algorithms for Computing Groebner Bases in Free Algebras (2025)

cases.interpretation: Published algorithmic stress test: enveloping algebra of the free metabelian Lie algebra on three generators. Not claimed as a distinct physical theory.
cases.adaptation: Six signed nonzero commutator-of-commutator generators; deleting duplicates would leave the same ideal but this keeps six as in the cited benchmark.

cases.name: lp1

sources.title: Hofstadler and Levandovskyy, Modular Algorithms for Computing Groebner Bases in Free Algebras (2025)

cases.interpretation: Published mixed defining-degree (3 and 4), homogeneous-per-relation algebraic stress test; not assigned an invented physical interpretation.
cases.adaptation: Same displayed polynomials; order z>y>x explicitly fixed. Paper signature-degree bounds are not identical to our inclusive polynomial-degree bounds.
